DIAGNQSTICS - AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE (U240E)
O/D Cancel Signal Circuit I)
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
While driving uphill with cruise control activated, in order to minimize gear shifting and provide smooth cruis­
ing overdrive may be prohibited temporarily under some condition.
The cruise control ECU sends 0/0 cut signals to the ECM as necessary and the ECM cancels overdrive
shifting until these signals are discontinued.
